::: {.profile-heading}
<h1>Sheng’en Li</h1>
:::

::: {.profile-bio}
I study Applied Mathematics and Computer Science as an undergraduate in the dual-degree program at [Duke Kunshan University](https://www.dukekunshan.edu.cn/) and [Duke University](https://duke.edu/).

My research asks how to evaluate and improve learning and decision systems when decisions shape future data, observations depend on past ones, or we are uncertain about the model. My work spans counterfactual evaluation, sequential detection, and numerical verification.

Oh, and these are my [notes](blog/index.qmd){.intro-link .intro-notes} and [tools](tools.qmd){.intro-link .intro-tools}. You might want to have a look.
:::
::::
